title: Iran Says No Foreign Flights Cancelled Despite US Sanctions Threat
detail: Iran's civil aviation authority stated that no foreign airlines have cancelled flights to or from Iran despite a renewed US threat of secondary sanctions targeting carriers operating in Iranian airspace. The announcement signals Tehran's attempt to project resilience in its commercial aviation sector amid ongoing military pressure and the broader US maximum-pressure campaign.

media.caption: Iran signals resilience in civil aviation sector amid US sanctions pressure

title: Trump Tells UN He Must 'Make a Deal' With Iran or 'Annihilate' It
detail: President Trump told the UN General Assembly he faced a choice on Iran: strike a deal that lets it 'rebuild and create a far greater country than it ever was before,' or 'annihilate the Islamic Republic and do it quickly, never giving them a chance to destroy people and countries again.' Trump called Iran the 'No. 1 sponsor of terror' and said 'while others have talked, I have acted,' referencing the Feb 28 US-Israeli strikes that opened the war. The remarks, delivered directly to Iran's UN delegation, set up a defiant rebuttal from President Pezeshkian the following day.

media.caption: Trump tells the UN General Assembly he must 'make a deal' with Iran or 'annihilate' the country
